transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ____. What brings you in today?

Hello, Doctor. It is a pleasure to meet you. Thank you for taking the time to see me. I, ah... well, I hope I'm explaining this correctly. I wouldn't normally make a fuss, I really try to be a good tenant and get along with everyone, but... I've been dealing with a rather difficult situation at my apartment. 

I'm used to looking at data and patterns for my work, and... well, for months now, the property manager and certain people in the building have been, um... they've been trying to pressure me out of my unit. I know how that sounds, and I really hope you don't think I'm being unreasonable or difficult. It's just that they use these subtle tactics, like deliberately misdelivering my mail, or... or making these perfectly timed noises in the walls right when I sit down to rest. And the neighbors will make these little pointed comments in passing. 

They've tried to show me paperwork and give me all sorts of routine explanations to brush it off, but... well, no amount of their explaining changes the pattern I can clearly see happening right in front of me. Does that make sense? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right information and not sounding like a bother.
Have you ever considered that these incidents might have a non-paranoid explanation, or are you completely certain that your neighbors and property manager are intentionally targeting you?

Oh, I... I definitely have. I mean, "paranoid" is such a... a strong word, and I really don't want you to think I'm the sort of person who just jumps to wild conclusions. I hope you don't think that of me. I always try to look for the logical, everyday explanation first. I really do. 

When it all started months ago, I told myself the misdelivered mail was just a careless postman, and... and that the noises in the walls were just the building settling. I really tried to give everyone the benefit of the doubt. 

But... well, I'm an analyst, you see. I look at data. And when you look at the whole picture—the property manager, certain people in the building... it's the way it all aligns. The noises are perfectly timed to disrupt my rest, and the neighbors make these little comments that fit right into it. It's all designed to pressure me out of the apartment. They've handed me paperwork and given me all these routine explanations, and I always accept them politely because I don't want to be a nuisance or seem combative. But... no amount of their paperwork or explanations changes the pattern I can clearly see right in front of me. 

I'm... I'm quite certain of what's happening, even though I really, really wish I wasn't. Am I... am I explaining that in a way that makes sense? I just want to be completely honest with you and make sure I'm answering your question properly.
Have you been hearing or seeing things that other people do not?

Oh, goodness, no. No, certainly not. I... I really hope I haven't given you the impression that I'm, well, imagining things. I know it's a perfectly standard question for you to ask, and I completely understand why you'd need to check, but... I assure you, my mind is quite sound. 

I don't hear voices or see anything that isn't really there. The noises I mentioned earlier, the ones in the walls, they're actual, physical sounds. Anyone sitting in my apartment would hear them just as clearly as I do. It's just the timing of them that I've been analyzing. 

I just... I want to make sure you know I'm completely grounded in reality. Am I being clear about that? I really want to be as helpful and accurate as possible for you, Doctor, and I'd hate for you to think I'm losing my faculties.
How long have you been certain that your neighbors and property manager are targeting you?

Well, um... I suppose it's been a little while now. I... I really didn't want to jump to any conclusions right away, of course. I tried my best to just settle in quietly and be a good neighbor when I first arrived. 

But, looking at the timeline of events... I'd say this has been going on for about 11 months. Basically since shortly after I moved into the new apartment. 

I hope I didn't wait too long to bring it up. I just... I really wanted to be absolutely certain before making any sort of fuss, so I wouldn't be wasting your time or anyone else's. I try very hard not to be a bother. Is it... is it alright that I took the time to be sure before talking to someone about it? I just want to make sure I'm handling this the right way.
Have you noticed any changes in your work or day-to-day functioning since this started?

Well, um... I suppose there have been a few small adjustments. I really, really try to keep everything running smoothly, though. I don't want anyone to think I'm letting things slip, because I do pride myself on being professional and reliable. 

But... well, to be completely honest, I have pulled back from a few of my consulting jobs lately. Not because I can't do the work! I just... I needed a little more flexibility in my schedule. And, um, my painting... I usually love to paint in the evenings, but I haven't quite found the time for it recently. 

It's just that I spend a good portion of my week having to, well, follow up on things. Checking in with the building staff, speaking with the various offices, keeping an eye on what the neighbors are doing... just to make sure everything is documented properly, you know? It takes up rather a lot of time, and it's made it a bit difficult to settle into my normal routine. 

I hope you don't think less of me for stepping back from work a bit. I just felt it was the responsible thing to do, to manage the situation here first. Does that... does that sound like a reasonable way to handle things? I really am trying to manage it all as best as I can.
Have you noticed any odd beliefs or experiences that others would consider bizarre or very unusual, beyond the apartment situation?

Oh, heavens, no. No, nothing like that at all. I... I really hope I haven't given you the impression that I'm prone to, well, flights of fancy or anything unusual. I try very, very hard to keep a level head about everything in my life. 

It's strictly just this one very specific issue with the apartment and the people there. Outside of that, everything is perfectly ordinary. I manage my affairs, I keep up with the news, I chat with old colleagues... all very sensibly, I assure you. I wouldn't want you to worry that my mind is playing tricks on me in other areas, because I really do pride myself on being objective and rational. 

Is... is that what you were asking? I just want to be absolutely sure I'm giving you the right information and not causing you any unnecessary concern.
Have you ever had similar beliefs about people targeting you before this apartment situation?

Oh, no. No, never. Um... I've always prided myself on getting along quite well with my colleagues and neighbors in the past. In all my years—working as an analyst and, well, just living my life—I've never had any reason to think anyone was, you know, out to get me or targeting me in any way. I've always tried my very best to be a cooperative, agreeable person. 

I really hope you don't think I'm the sort of man who just goes around looking for conflict or making up problems. I'm truly not, I promise you. This situation at the apartment is... well, it's entirely new to me, which is why it's been so terribly upsetting to navigate. I just want everything to be peaceful and proper. 

Does that... does that make sense? I hope I'm answering your questions the right way. I just want to assure you that I've never had any sort of trouble with people acting this way toward me before I moved here.
Have you noticed any trouble keeping your thoughts organized or making sense when you speak?

Oh, goodness, no. I... I really don't think so. I've always prided myself on being quite articulate, actually. With my background as an analyst, keeping information organized in my head is... well, it's essential, really. I always try very hard to speak clearly and make sure I'm understood. 

I haven't noticed any... any jumbling of my words or losing my train of thought. I mean, I'm making sense to you now, aren't I? I truly hope I haven't been rambling or confusing you during our chat today. I just want to make sure I'm being as helpful and clear as I possibly can be for you. Am I communicating everything alright?
Have you been feeling persistently down or depressed most days lately?

Oh, no, no, not at all. I mean, of course, the situation with the apartment is... well, it's quite stressful, naturally. Anyone would find it a bit taxing. But depressed? Oh, certainly not. 

I still find plenty of joy in my day-to-day routine. I like to keep my chin up, you know? I make sure I get out for a walk, I read my journals... I try to stay very positive and proactive about things. I really wouldn't want you to think I'm just sitting around moping or letting this whole business drag me down into despair. I'm doing my absolute best to handle it all with a good attitude. 

I seem fairly upbeat to you, don't I? I just want to make sure I'm giving you an accurate picture of my mood. I'm really quite fine in that regard, I promise.
Before this apartment situation began, have you ever heard voices or seen things that other people could not?

Oh, heavens, no. No, never anything like that. Um... I know sometimes people who are, well, perhaps struggling with their faculties might experience things of that nature, but I certainly haven't. My mind has always been quite sharp, I assure you. 

I've always been very grounded, which is exactly why this whole business at the building has been so deeply unsettling for me. I... I really hope you don't suspect I'm just imagining things or losing my grip, because I promise you, I'm not that sort of person at all. I've never heard any voices or seen anything that wasn't really there, I swear it. 

Is... is that what you needed to know? I'm doing my absolute best to be completely transparent with you, and I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right information. I hope I'm being helpful.
Have you experienced any other unusual beliefs, beyond the apartment situation?

Oh, no, definitely not. My goodness, I... I wouldn't want you to think I go around harboring all sorts of strange notions. I'm a very rational person, really I am. As an analyst, my whole career was built on facts and logic, so I don't just... invent things or jump to wild conclusions. 

The situation at the building is... well, it's a very specific, isolated issue, and it's based on actual things that are happening to me there. But outside of that? No, absolutely nothing out of the ordinary. I go about my life, I pay my bills, I read the paper... I'm just a normal, everyday sort of fellow. 

I haven't said anything that makes you think I have other... odd ideas, have I? I really hope I'm coming across as the sensible person I am. I just want to be sure you understand that this apartment business is the only thing that's been troubling me. Does that make sense?
Have you had any experiences like hearing voices, seeing things, or other unusual perceptions in the past month?

Oh, no, Doctor, not at all in the past month. I mean, just as I was saying before, I really don't experience anything like that. No voices, no visions, nothing... nothing unusual like that. 

I know you have to ask these things to be thorough, and I completely understand, but I can assure you my senses are perfectly intact. I wouldn't want to give you the wrong impression and have you think I'm... well, that I'm dealing with something like that on top of everything else. 

I've been very careful to monitor myself, you know, just to be sure I'm staying clear-headed through all this stress. I'm answering these questions correctly, aren't I? I just want to make sure I'm giving you exactly what you need to understand my situation properly. I'm doing my best to be a good patient for you.
Have you noticed yourself becoming more socially withdrawn or emotionally less expressive over time?

Oh, dear, no. I wouldn't say that at all. I mean... well, I am retired now, so naturally I don't have the daily bustle of the office anymore, but I'm still quite a sociable fellow. And emotionally... well, I certainly feel things just as deeply as I always have. I've always prided myself on being a warm, approachable person. 

I suppose anyone dealing with the sort of... well, the stressful situation I've been facing at the building might stay indoors a bit more just to keep a careful eye on things, but I certainly haven't shut myself away from the world. 

I... I hope I don't seem flat or unexpressive to you today? I'm really trying my best to be engaging and open with you. I want to make sure we have a good rapport and that I'm being pleasant to talk to. Am I coming across alright in that regard?
Do you believe anything impossible or clearly against reality is happening, such as being controlled, monitored by hidden devices, or having your thoughts read?

Oh, goodness me, no. No, certainly not. I mean... having my thoughts read or being controlled by some sort of hidden devices? That’s... well, that’s just the stuff of science fiction movies, isn't it? 

I assure you, Doctor, I don't believe anything impossible is going on. I know the difference between what's real and what's fantasy. As an analyst, you have to be grounded in the real world, and I've always carried that with me. The... the trouble I've been having at the apartment, it's all very tangible, everyday sort of interference. It's nothing supernatural or... or bizarre. 

I haven't said anything to make you suspect I'm losing touch with reality, have I? I really do try to be as objective as possible about my situation. I just... I want to make sure you know I'm a sensible man. Am I making sense to you? I really hope I'm not coming across as foolish or irrational today.
Have you had any periods of feeling unusually energized or needing much less sleep than usual?

Oh, no, Doctor. I've always been a very steady sleeper. I mean, I try to get my full eight hours every night, just like the experts recommend. I certainly haven't had any... any bursts of wild energy or felt like I didn't need to rest. 

I know some people get like that, running around at all hours, but I've always been very disciplined about my routine. Even with the... the stress of the neighbors and the noises, I make sure to lay down and try to get proper rest so I can stay sharp. I wouldn't want to let myself get run down and frantic, you know? 

I hope that's the right sort of answer? I just want to reassure you that I'm taking good care of my health and keeping a very level, normal schedule. I'm doing alright with these questions, aren't I?
Have you noticed your emotions becoming noticeably flatter or less responsive than they used to be?

Oh, um... I believe we might have touched on that just a moment ago, Doctor, when you asked about being less expressive? But no, to answer you directly, I certainly haven't noticed my emotions flattening out at all. 

My feelings are just as... well, just as vibrant and responsive as they've always been. I still laugh at a good joke, I still feel deep affection for my friends and family, and I still get upset when... well, when things are genuinely upsetting. If anything, I try very hard to stay positive and engaged, especially when I'm speaking with someone like yourself. 

I... I hope my face isn't looking blank or stiff right now? I'm really trying to be as open and helpful as I can be today. I want to make sure I'm giving you the right information. Am I answering these questions the way you need me to?
Have you ever had a period when you were clearly unable to tell what was real because of hallucinations or very disorganized thinking?

Oh, no, definitely not. Goodness, that sounds dreadful, doesn't it? Being unable to tell what's real... no, I've never experienced anything like that. 

As I mentioned, I've always prided myself on being very clear-headed. My thinking is quite organized—I mean, you have to be to work as an analyst for as long as I did. You have to keep everything very structured and logical. I certainly haven't seen or heard anything that wasn't really there. The things happening around me, they're very real, very tangible issues. 

I would be terribly embarrassed if I ever lost my grip like that. I always want to present myself as a sensible, rational person. I... I hope I'm coming across that way to you? I'm really doing my best to be clear and helpful. I haven't said anything that sounds disorganized, have I?
Have you had any other unusual beliefs or suspicious ideas outside of the apartment situation?

Oh, no, Doctor. No, nothing like that. Outside of the... the trouble at the apartment, my life is very quiet. Very ordinary. 

I don't have any strange ideas or... or suspicions about people in general. I've always gotten along quite well with my colleagues when I was working, and I have a lovely relationship with my family. I certainly don't go around looking for conspiracies or anything silly like that. I'm a very practical man. It's just... well, it's just the very specific, very real issue with the neighbors that's been so taxing. 

Everything else is perfectly normal, I assure you. I wouldn't want you to think I was the sort of person who is just generally... paranoid, or making things up. I'm a very reasonable person. I hope you can see that? I'm trying to give you a very accurate picture of things. I'm doing okay, aren't I?
